claims.claim: Vancouver voters said yes to two plebiscite questions championed by outgoing mayor Ken Sim on open-air hard drug use and involuntary care.
claims.episode_span: Voters said yes to both plebiscite questions championed by outgoing mayor Ken Sim.
claims.source_title: Vancouver residents vote yes on 2 plebiscite questions regarding drug use
claims.supporting_quote: The plebiscite questions, championed by outgoing mayor Ken Sim, had proposed strengthening the city's laws to "forbid open-air hard drug use" and pushing the province for more involuntary care treatment at a soon-to-be-closed downtown hospital site.
